description: Fork of exp144 (E=64, qk_tph=384, 392M, final 1.7101 — current E=64 SOTA). Skip V2D on Q/K entirely: pass real-valued qk_lut output through LayerNorm directly to SDPA. Widen d_qk 32 -> 64 (qk_lut now produces 2*d_qk = 128 outputs per head, split into Q[64] and K[64]). LayerNorm on Q and K before SDPA standardises magnitudes regardless of LUT init scale (first attempt without LN failed: tiny init magnitudes ~0.02 made attention uniform during warmup). attn_scale_init = 1/sqrt(64) ≈ 0.125. Param impact: qk LUT doubles + 2 LayerNorms per layer. Per-layer qk: 37.75M -> 75.5M (+37.75M). 6 layers: +226.5M. Estimated total: ~620M.
